supported_domain.name: single-target-literal-agreement-v1
supported_domain.pair_rule: Literal output equality must agree with equality after each string's Unicode strip(), then ASCII boundary whitespace/punctuation stripping.
supported_domain.unsupported: Unequal strings collapsed together by boundary stripping; array or multiple targets; native scorer configuration or detail drift.
supported_domain.preserved: Equal strings including leading/trailing whitespace or punctuation, internal whitespace/punctuation, Unicode and empty strings remain eligible. Distinct normalized strings remain eligible mismatches.
supported_domain.metric: The independent qualification still uses byte-exact equality; no normalization is added to the accepted metric.

qualification_status: requires fresh execution; historical evidence is not promoted to this runner identity
